race.description: The William Farrer Hotel Country Boosted Hcp (C3)
race.comment: DIAMOND FROST (7) in career best form and sent to town with a struggling twelfth over 1400m at Rosehill in Highway grade. Assess on the good earlier efforts and can return to from from the rails gate. HIP HIP OLE (3) is a progressive mare who won the Wagga Guineas Prelude over 1400m here last April. Struggled in her two subsequent runs and expected to go on with it this time in. BONNIE MURRINGO (5) Wagga trained mare resuming. Caught the eye two back when fifth over 1400m at Randwick in Highway class. Primed with the one trial placing over 1000m and the blinkers come off. Top three player. SERENADING (9) drops in weight for this and can improve on her second up sixth over 1200m at this track. Has the speed to get over from the wide barrier and worth thought.
